mapper.select: SELECT b.ENUM_DSCR AS TASK_TYPE_DSCR, a.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME, a.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME, c.`guoku_dscr` AS INSPECTED_GUOKU_DSCR FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task` a JOIN ( SELECT t1.`ENUM_DSCR`, t1.ENUM_ID FROM `enumset`.`cm_guoku_enumeration` t1 WHERE t1.`ENUM_TYPE_ID` = '12' ) b ON b.`ENUM_ID` = a.INSPECTION_TASK_TYPE LEFT JOIN dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` c ON a.`INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID` = c.`guoku_id` WHERE a.INSPECTION_TASK_ID = #{params.TASK_ID};

SELECT a.QUESTION_ID_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2, b.QUESTION_DSCR AS QUESTION_DSCR_1, c.QUESTION_DSCR AS QUESTION_DSCR_2 FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` b ON a.`QUESTION_ID_1` = b.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` c ON a.`QUESTION_ID_2` = c.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` cc ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = cc.QUESTION_ID WHERE
cc.`QUESTION_DSCR` <> '其他'
cc.`QUESTION_DSCR` = '其他'
AND a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.`ADD_USERID` = #{params.ADD_USERID} GROUP BY a.QUESTION_ID_1, a.QUESTION_ID_2 ORDER BY a.ADD_DATE

SELECT a.QUESTION_ID, a.QUESTION_CONTENT, d.QUESTION_OPINIONS, e.RULE_FILE_NAME, e.RULE_FILE_NO, e.RULE_FILE_CONTENT FROM inspection.`inspection_question_ledger` a JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` d ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = d.QUESTION_ID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_question_bank` cc ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = cc.QUESTION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT t1.RULE_FILE_NAME, t1.RULE_FILE_NO, t1.RULE_FILE_CONTENT, t2.`QUESTION_ID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_question_rule` t1 JOIN inspection.`inspection_question_rule_relation` t2 ON t1.RULE_ID = t2.`RULE_ID` WHERE t1.RULE_STATE = '0') e ON a.`QUESTION_ID` = e.QUESTION_ID WHERE
cc.`QUESTION_DSCR` <> '其他'
cc.`QUESTION_DSCR` = '其他'
AND a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} AND a.`ADD_USERID` = #{params.ADD_USERID} AND a.QUESTION_ID_2 = #{params.QUESTION_ID_2} GROUP BY a.QUESTION_CONTENT ORDER BY a.ADD_DATE
